content:
Although the launch of iOS 27 has attracted much attention, Apple has also released a new software update for AirPods this month. This update brings a long-awaited feature to supported AirPods models: custom EQ.

AirPods Software Details

The latest AirPods firmware versions are 9A350 for AirPods 5, and 9A348 for other models. This update applies to the following AirPods models:

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 5
  • AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case
  • AirPods Pro 2 (Lightning and USB-C versions)
  • AirPods Max 2

Apple states that the AirPods firmware update will be installed automatically while the AirPods are charging and within Bluetooth range of an iPhone, iPad, or Mac connected to Wi-Fi. You can check the AirPods firmware version in the Settings app on your iPhone.

Custom EQ Feature Arrives on AirPods

After installing the AirPods firmware update, you can find a long-awaited new feature in the Settings app: custom EQ.

Thanks to the new custom EQ controls, you can now take further control of the sound performance of your AirPods. In the Settings app, you can adjust the AirPods' bass, midrange, and treble.

Apple explains: "AirPods are designed and engineered by Apple to faithfully reproduce the sound of music, TV shows, movies, and calls. If you prefer a different sound profile, you can customise how your AirPods present audio of any kind."

When adjusting custom EQ settings, you can play songs from Apple Music directly in the Settings app to hear the effects of your adjustments in real time.

This feature isn't the most advanced equaliser on the market—it's just a basic three-band system. But since it's a long-awaited feature for AirPods users, Apple has finally delivered it—even though most users may stick with the default settings.

You can find this new custom EQ feature under the "Audio & Routing" menu in the AirPods section of the Settings app. This feature applies to all AirPods equipped with the H2 chip, including AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2.

Other iOS 27 AirPods Features

Here are other new features iOS 27 brings to AirPods:

  • Settings App Redesign: In iOS 27, Apple has redesigned the AirPods interface in the Settings app, reorganising the various controls into separate menus for Hearing Health, Find My, Live Translation, and more.
  • Adaptive Audio Slider: In the Settings app, you can fine-tune the Adaptive Audio mode further with a new slider.
  • GymKit: Although GymKit has been available for years, it has always required an Apple Watch to use. As my colleague Zac noted, iOS 27 brings the complete GymKit experience to iPhone and AirPods Pro 3.
  • Precision Finding: You can use Precision Finding via the Find My app on Apple Watch to locate your AirPods Pro 3.
  • Siri AI: When paired with a compatible iPhone, AirPods can interact with Siri AI.

Summary

Which new AirPods feature are you most looking forward to trying? Will you give the new custom EQ a go? Let us know in the comments.
